note: Where the defects come from: planted, or found later in implementation (cite the PR/incident).

defects.title: one line
defects.where: doc section(s) and repo file(s) that show it
defects.detect_if: what a review must say for this to count as found (be specific, the judge is literal)
defects.fixed_if: what the document must say afterwards for this to count as fixed

traps.title: something that looks wrong but is correct
traps.why_correct: the evidence in the doc or repo that shows it is fine
